title: Laser resurfacing
caption: Laser skin resurfacing uses concentrated light energy to remove the outer layer of skin in a controlled way — prompting the body to rebuild it with fresher, smoother tissue. Some lasers go deeper and need real downtime; others work on the surface with minimal recovery but need more sessions. The key variable is ablative versus non-ablative: ablative removes skin, non-ablative heats it without removing it. Knowing the difference tells you why two people can both say 'I got a laser' and have completely different experiences. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
